title: Checkout API returning 500 errors
description: Users reported checkout failing with generic 500 errors during a flash sale. Database connections were being held open longer than expected under high concurrent load, exhausting the connection pool.
rootCause: Connection pool size was set too low for peak traffic; a slow query was also holding connections open longer than necessary.
resolution: Increased pool size from 10 to 50 and added a query timeout of 3s to force-release stuck connections.

title: Third-party shipping API timeouts
description: Order fulfillment jobs started failing silently. Logs showed repeated timeouts calling the external shipping rate API, but no alert had been configured for that dependency.
rootCause: Shipping provider had an undocumented rate limit that was hit during a promotional traffic spike.
resolution: Added exponential backoff and a circuit breaker around the shipping API client; added alerting on upstream latency.

title: Auth service login failures spike
description: A large number of users were unexpectedly logged out and could not log back in. Token validation was failing for tokens issued before a recent deploy.
rootCause: A signing key rotation was deployed without a grace period, invalidating all previously issued tokens immediately.
resolution: Rolled back key rotation, then re-deployed with dual-key validation supporting both old and new keys during a transition window.

title: Search results returning empty for valid queries
description: Users searching for recently added products got zero results. The search index was found to be several hours out of sync with the product database.
rootCause: The background indexing job had crashed silently two days prior due to an unhandled exception on a malformed product entry.
resolution: Fixed the malformed-data edge case, restarted indexing, and added a dead-man's-switch alert if indexing hasn't run in 30 minutes.

title: Notification service sending duplicate emails
description: Customers reported receiving the same order confirmation email 3-5 times within a minute. Message queue consumers appeared to be reprocessing the same messages.
rootCause: Consumer acknowledgements were not being sent before a deploy restarted the pods, causing the queue to redeliver unacknowledged messages.
resolution: Implemented idempotency keys on the email-send handler so duplicate deliveries are safely ignored.

title: API gateway rate limiting legitimate traffic
description: Several enterprise customers reported random 429 errors during normal usage, well below their expected quota.
rootCause: Rate limiting was keyed by IP address instead of API key, so customers behind shared corporate NATs were incorrectly bucketed together.
resolution: Switched rate limiting to be keyed by API key/account ID instead of IP address.

title: Payments webhook events processed out of order
description: A refund was applied before the original charge had finished processing, leaving an account balance in an inconsistent state.
rootCause: Webhook events were processed concurrently by multiple workers without any ordering guarantee per customer.
resolution: Added per-customer sequential processing using a partition key so events for the same customer are always processed in order.

title: Image upload service running out of disk space
description: User profile picture uploads started failing. The instance's local disk was found to be at 100% capacity.
rootCause: Temporary upload files were not being cleaned up after processing due to a missing cleanup step in an error path.
resolution: Added a cleanup step in the finally block and a scheduled job to purge stale temp files older than 1 hour.

title: Recommendation service returning stale results
description: Users continued to see recommendations based on old browsing behavior even after significant new activity.
rootCause: The cache invalidation trigger was tied to a message queue topic that had been silently renamed during a refactor, so no invalidation events were arriving.
resolution: Fixed the topic name mismatch and added a monitoring check comparing cache freshness against source data.

title: Database CPU spike causing site-wide slowness
description: All services experienced elevated latency. Database CPU utilization was pegged at 100% for 40 minutes.
rootCause: A newly deployed analytics query was missing an index and was performing a full table scan on every request.
resolution: Added the missing index and moved the analytics query to a read replica instead of the primary database.

title: Inventory count going negative
description: Several products showed negative stock counts after a high-traffic sale event, allowing overselling.
rootCause: Stock decrement was implemented as a read-then-write operation without locking, causing lost updates under concurrent purchases.
resolution: Replaced with an atomic database decrement operation with a floor constraint at zero.

title: Session tokens expiring prematurely
description: Users on mobile were being logged out every few minutes despite normal activity, even though desktop sessions were fine.
rootCause: Mobile clients were sending requests with a clock that had drifted, causing token expiry checks (which relied on client-reported time) to fail early.
resolution: Switched token expiry validation to rely solely on server time instead of trusting client timestamps.

title: Background report generation jobs timing out
description: Monthly report generation for large enterprise accounts started failing to complete within the job timeout window.
rootCause: Report size had grown with customer data volume over time, and the job's fixed timeout was never revisited.
resolution: Made timeout configurable per account size and split large reports into paginated background chunks.

title: CDN serving outdated static assets
description: Users reported seeing an old version of the website UI after a new deploy, even after hard refresh.
rootCause: Cache-control headers on the build assets were set to a 24-hour TTL without cache-busting filenames per deploy.
resolution: Added content-hash-based filenames to static assets so each deploy naturally invalidates the CDN cache.

title: Third-party payment provider outage
description: All card payments began failing with generic gateway errors. Status page for the payment provider confirmed a full outage.
rootCause: External dependency outage, not caused by our own systems, but no fallback provider was configured.
resolution: Integrated a secondary payment provider as a fallback and added automatic failover logic when the primary returns elevated error rates.
